newsitem.title: RWANDA: Rwandan gang murders Spanish aid workers.
newsitem.headline: Rwandan gang murders Spanish aid workers.

text.p: Three Spanish aid workers were murdered -- shot through the head in cold blood -- when Hutu militiamen raided the houses of aid workers in Ruhengeri, northwest Rwanda, on Saturday night, survivors said.
Earlier reports had indicated that they were Rwandan aid workers. In addition, three Rwandan soldiers were killed and an American was wounded, and later had his leg amputated.
Bodies of the dead -- two men and a woman -- lay in pools of blood when a Reuters correspondent reached the scene on Sunday.
They were attached to Medicos del Mundo (Doctors of the World), a Spanish aid organisation.
"These people were executed. Clearly these attacks were aimed at aid workers and expatriates generally," United Nations Human Rights Operation director Javier Zuniga told Reuters.
